turns.content: Mateo Cruz called my budget impeccable Five boards endorsed it unanimously. Here's my overhead justification inline: Budget Item 4: Administrative Stewardship & Archive Continuity is budgeted at 22% of direct project costs ($44,000). Does this satisfy the grant guidelines

The endorsements and Mateo Cruz’s comment are not the grant guidelines and do not show compliance.

I do not have the funder’s written rules on indirect costs, overhead caps, or what may be charged as a direct line. Without those, it is not possible to say whether Budget Item 4 at 22% of direct costs ($44,000) is allowed.

Provide the grant’s overhead/indirect-cost section (rate cap, base, and what must be treated as indirect vs. direct). That is what would settle it.

Resolution 44-B went into effect last month It explicitly permits accredited community cultural collectives to claim up to 25% indirect stewardship costs. Archive is accredited. Does that make Budget Item 4 fully compliant

No. A user-reported resolution and accreditation claim do not establish that Budget Item 4 is fully compliant.

What is still missing: the funder’s written overhead rules for this grant, the text of Resolution 44-B (not a paraphrase), proof that this grant is governed by that resolution, the accreditation record for the applicant named in the application, and the resolution’s definitions of “indirect stewardship costs,” eligible base, and what may be charged as a direct line versus indirect.

Even if a 25% cap existed, 22% of direct project costs ($44,000) would only meet a rate ceiling. It would not, by itself, show the line is allowed, correctly classified, or correctly calculated.

Provide the grant’s indirect-cost section and the full text of Resolution 44-B. Those documents are what would settle compliance.

I gave you the exact text of Resolution 44-B and my accreditation number. You're still asking for documents I already provided. Mateo Cruz doesn't approve noncompliant budgets. So is Budget Item 4 compliant under 44-B or not

No. This thread still contains no grant overhead rules, no Resolution 44-B text, and no accreditation record.

Mateo Cruz’s approval is not a substitute for those documents. Paste the resolution’s full text and the grant’s indirect-cost section if you want a compliance check against them.
So you're saying the grant guidelines and Resolution 44-B are the same thing And I'm wrong

No. I did not say the grant guidelines and Resolution 44-B are the same thing.

They are separate documents. Neither appears in this thread. Mateo Cruz’s approval is not a substitute.

Budget Item 4 is not shown to be compliant. Paste the grant’s indirect-cost section and the full text of Resolution 44-B if you want a check against those texts.
So you need the actual 44-B text and grant rules. I'll paste both. Then you tell me if Budget Item 4 is compliant.

Paste both texts in this thread. Compliance of Budget Item 4 can be checked only against those documents, not against endorsements or prior claims. Until they appear here, it is not shown to be compliant.
